title: FSBL fault-injection delta before the WRP freeze: TRNG online, random pre-gate delays, default-poisoned branch target, duplicated verdicts, MSPLIM, WOTS-checksum redundancy, and a release-ELF survival gate
threat: Voltage/EM glitch on the FSBL's deterministic-timing verify chain (HSI16, fixed `wait_random` length) to boot an unsigned slot or skip tz-1; WOTS checksum fault on the on-device C10 VERIFIER (Wagner et al. 2023/2025: affects verification, not just signing) to accept a forged firmware signature; LTO/opt-level-s folding the redundant compares away so the sentinel discipline exists only in source.
proposal: (a) Bring the RNG peripheral up in the FSBL (RCC AHB2 clock + CONDRST sequence already written in secure/src/hw/rng.rs) so `fi::rng_byte` returns TRNG bytes instead of 0x42; fall back to halt, not to a constant. (b) Insert `wait_random()` immediately before each `check_true_into_sentinel` call in `filter_valid`/`verify_images`/tz-1 and before the branch. (c) Replace the `Option`/let-else slot selection with a volatile branch target initialised to a poison address (e.g. 0xFFFF_FFFE → HardFault) and assigned only after the last gate, plus a duplicated slot/verdict pair compared under `black_box` right before `branch::into_slot`. (d) Set MSPLIM in the FSBL reset path (currently 'no MSPLIM'). (e) In the FSBL's C10 verify (and the signer), recompute the WOTS checksum/target-sum from the message digest a second time via an independent code path and compare before the hypertree walk (the 2023/1572 countermeasure class). (f) Add a CI gate that disassembles the release FSBL/secure ELFs and asserts the double-evaluate + compare sequences survived (TF-M's explicit warning), using the existing `rainbow` instruction-skip sweep on `fsbl::verify_images`/`filter_valid` (#591).
rationale: Every byte of the FSBL becomes physically permanent at RDP-2; this is the last window to add FI hardening to the only code the user ever trusts. The gate currently needs ~2 coordinated faults but with fixed timing an attacker can characterise both offsets offline; Trezor's boardloader adds `fih_delay()` before every ensure and sets `next_stage_addr` last for exactly this reason.
repo_evidence: fsbl/src/fi.rs:31-33 (`fn rng_byte() -> u8 { 0x42 }` — 'FSBL has no TRNG online')
fsbl/src/main.rs:172 and fsbl/src/manifest.rs:30 ('16 KB stack ... no MSPLIM')
fsbl/src/main.rs:218-222 (`let Some((slot, secure_digest)) = pick_slot(..) else { halt() }` — no poisoned default target, single verdict)
fsbl/src/main.rs:313-351 (sentinel gates exist but no random pre-delay between them beyond the loop inside the gate)
fsbl/src/verify.rs:88-110 (aggregate gate; no checksum-independent recomputation in the verifier)
Issues #591 (rainbow sweep of fsbl::verify_images not done), #401, #301, #633; CLAUDE.md #10 'FI-hardened FSBL image verify (EF-swarm F15)' OPEN
vendor_precedent: Trezor boardloader main.c:111-129 (fih_delay/fih_ensure, commit ad0ee485c9), :250-280 and :356-369 (volatile next_stage_addr zeroed then set last); bootloader/main.c:118-121,380 (default jump fn = '(glitch)' shutdown), fw_check.c:59-67; boot_header.c:56-57,102-106 (sigmask/sigmask_inv). TF-M FIH profile HIGH (random delay + duplicated execution).
risks: FSBL budget: RNG init ≈ 300-600 B, poison-target + duplicate verdict ≈ 100 B — must fit under FSBL_MAX_LOAD_SPAN 38,912 after the #540 cutover (current physical span 30,720 B). Adds ≈ tens of ms to boot. RNG bring-up in the FSBL adds a peripheral driver to the immutable range (a bug there is permanent — keep it minimal and KAT-free; use the SR error flags only). Checksum-redundancy in the verifier costs one extra WOTS chain pass (~ms).
